messages:
selena: Quick logistics question 1 I'm hosting a pair of contractors Mon at 3pm. One might swing by earlier with a large framed print. Can front desk accept awkward parcels and stick them in storage? Any preferred label to put on it?
omar: Yep, front desk can accept. Please have them label: 'Selena - Mon meeting'. If it's fragile, ask them to mark FRAGILE and include a contact number.
bo: If its big and heavy, we usually put it in the mailroom trolley and tag it in the system. If it's just a frame, locker #6 is usually free.
selena: Great 2 I'll ask them to mark FRAGILE and leave my mobile. Might be a 3ft frame.
mailroom-bot: New incoming delivery recorded: carrier=ExpressDrop, ETA=Mon 10:20, dimensions=36x24x6in, recipient=Selena. Recommended hold: mailroom trolley.
frontdesk-bot: Heads-up: walk-in visitors are fine but pre-registration by 1:30pm gets express badges. Temp badges print as red stripe.
kelly: Seating choice? Poll: A) Conference table by kitchenette, B) Focus booth (privacy glass). React :one: for A, :two: for B.
omar: :two: Focus booth 2 quieter for contractor conversations.
bo: :one: Conference table if you expect collaborators to drop in.
selena: leaning :two: unless someone needs to project slides. I'll book Focus booth if it's free.
frontdesk-bot: Note: if delivery arrives unmanned, mailroom will hold and notify recipient. Locker #6 reserved until 4pm for "Selena - Mon meeting".
selena: Perfect 2 thanks team! I'll DM the courier and put names in the pre-reg by noon. :raised_hands:
